people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: even all that Yahweh has commanded you by Moses, from the day that Yahweh gave commandment and onward throughout your generations—
translations.bsb: all that the LORD has commanded you through Moses from the day the LORD gave them and continuing through the generations to come—
translations.kjv: Even all that the LORD hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the LORD commanded Moses, and henceforward among your generations;
translations.asv: even all that Jehovah hath commanded you by Moses, from the day that Jehovah gave commandment, and onward throughout your generations;
